speaker: Pep Guardiola
context: Pre-match press conference ahead of Manchester City's Premier League fixture away at Aston Villa (12 Feb 2023) — his first public response to the Premier League's referral of 115 alleged charges days earlier.
quote: My first thought is that we are already being condemned.

speaker: Pep Guardiola
context: Reported as part of the same wave of comments responding to the Feb 2023 charges. Exact press-conference date not independently pinned down beyond "Feb 2023 charges response" — verify before treating this date as exact.
quote: In the end, I know fairly that what we won we won on the pitch.

speaker: Pep Guardiola
context: Post-match press conference after Manchester City beat Watford 6-0 in the FA Cup final at Wembley, completing the domestic treble, when asked about Der Spiegel/Football Leaks reports that former manager Roberto Mancini received extra payments via a side deal with Al Jazira.
quote: Honestly, do you think I deserve to have this type of question? The day we won the treble, did I receive money? Are you accusing me of receiving money?

speaker: Pep Guardiola
context: Pre-match press conference before Manchester City's home game against Brentford, three days before the independent commission's hearing into the 115 charges opened (16 Sept 2024).
quote: An independent panel will decide. I'm looking forward to the decision.

speaker: Pep Guardiola
context: Same pre-Brentford press conference. Outlets differ on exact wording — some report "Everyone is innocent until proven guilty", others paraphrase as "innocent until guilt is proven". This entry uses the more directly quoted version; verify against a primary transcript before publishing.
quote: Everyone is innocent until proven guilty.

speaker: Pep Guardiola
context: Press conference on the day Manchester City announced his two-year contract extension (to 2027), asked about the risk of relegation as a sanction in the 115-charges case.
quote: I said that six months ago. If we get relegated, I will be here and next year we're going to come up to the Premier League. I knew it then, I feel it now.

speaker: Pep Guardiola
context: Made around his announced departure from Manchester City in May 2026 (exact day within May not independently confirmed beyond the announcement date), reiterating trust in the club over the 115-charges case as he prepared to leave.
quote: I trust them. I spoke with them and trust how they behave and how they did.
